about: Real books that exposed parse problems. The PDFs stay on the owner's disk (copyright) and are never committed; this file records where they are and what parsing them must give. Run with BOOK_AGENT_RUN_CORPUS_TESTS=1 uv run python -m pytest tests/test_parse_health_corpus.py -q -p no:cacheprovider. A missing file skips its book. Every change to parsing code must keep this passing (docs/agent-upgrade/08-pilot-quality-gate.md §9). Expected values recorded from main at 1767bd5 (2026-09-25).
